hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; if [ "${SDLC_KNOWLEDGE:-}" != off ] && ! grep -qsE '^[[:space:]]*enabled[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*false' .sdlc.toml && ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --no-project "$P" session-start; else exec python3 "$P" session-start; fi
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --no-project "$P" pre-edit; else exec python3 "$P" pre-edit; fi
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --no-project "$P" pre-bash; else exec python3 "$P" pre-bash; fi
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --no-project "$P" post-edit; else exec python3 "$P" post-edit; fi
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --no-project "$P" post-bash; else exec python3 "$P" post-bash; fi
